references.text: Joshua 21:41 confirms the total number of Levitical cities to be forty-eight, along with their pasturelands, fulfilling the command given in Numbers 35:7.
Joshua 21 describes the actual distribution of the forty-eight cities to the Levites from the various tribes, as ordered in Numbers 35.
The immediate context explains God's command to give cities and pasturelands to the Levites, which verse 7 summarizes by stating the total number.
Leviticus 25:32-34 contains laws regarding the Levitical cities and their pasturelands, showing that the Levites had special rights to their cities and surrounding areas.
1 Chronicles 6:39-66 provides a detailed list of the Levitical cities assigned to the various Levitical families, in accordance with the command in Numbers 35:7.
